title: Change Bill To opens and focuses the Customer card's Bill To field
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for, on the COD credit term.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, on the Credit Hold credit term.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Complete, ready to invoice, billed to customer B.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click "Change Bill To" in the banner.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A, with customer B's Credit Hold banner and "Change Bill To".

Step 2:

  • The page scrolls to the Customer card.
  • The Bill To field is focused and its list is open.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12309 (Story 7, Invoicing to the Bill To)

  • S7-R7: “"Change Bill To" opens and focuses the Customer card's Bill To field; on a phone it first opens the work order details.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: pictures "Change Bill To" (page 3 "When the Bill To is blocked", This build), "Phone, Change Bill To" (page 3 "When the Bill To is blocked", This build). Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.

The design's own words:

  • “"Change Bill To" opens and focuses the card's Bill To field, so the page scrolls to it.”
  • “Tapping "Change Bill To" opens the phone Details, scrolls to the Bill To field and opens its list: "Buda Truck Repair (this customer)", "Valders Diesel & Fleet Repair" highlighted, then customers A to Z.”
